1.1.0.en: Adds 'Everyone at home is asleep', which ignores anyone who is out, so a 'last one to bed' Flow still works when somebody is away for the evening. Adds a vacation status per user, with triggers, conditions, an action and a device: a user on vacation is left out of the 'everyone' cards, so those keep working for whoever is still around. Vacation can clear itself when Homey sees that person come home.

1.0.0.en: First release. Adds the household-wide condition cards Homey does not have: 'Everyone is at home' and 'Everyone is asleep'.

1.2.0.en: Adds 'Exactly one person at home is awake' - true when a single person is up while the others sleep or are out. Use it for a first-one-up morning Flow, or a last-one-still-awake evening Flow.

1.3.0.en: Adds the trigger 'The first person at home wakes up' - fires when someone who was asleep at home wakes while the others are still asleep. It deliberately does not fire in the evening when somebody goes to bed leaving one person awake, nor when somebody arrives home awake.

1.3.1.en: Fixes 'The last person at home goes to the status asleep' firing when the last awake person simply left the house - nobody had gone to bed. It now requires somebody to actually fall asleep. Both sleep triggers now carry a User tag naming who woke up first, or went to sleep last.

1.3.2.en: Housekeeping: vacation statuses for users who have since been deleted from Homey are now cleared away at startup instead of lingering in the app settings.

1.3.3.en: Fixes 'The first person at home wakes up' not firing at all when two people woke within the same moment - for example one alarm waking a couple. It now fires once for the household waking, whoever gets up.
